name: かしこくディズニー：パークの段取り名人
tagline: Plans a smarter park day, from date pick to day-of changes
description: A planning companion for a theme-park day that starts before tickets are bought: it helps you choose which date to go, read how crowded each option looks, and sketch a route that wastes less time in queues. On the day itself it adjusts the plan with you as conditions shift, folding in live chatter from X.
author: musicianmayo
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
